notes.title: Major Content Update
notes.notes: I have updated the game and requested it to be made free to play. New artwork added, story has been condensed, and new puzzles added and redistributed for Pacing reasons. Thank you to everyone for their support and help.

notes.title: Major Story Update Live
notes.notes: A new update has been pushed with a lighter feel to the GUI and a lot of new story content added. The new party members have been added and the story fleshed out greatly. Also the order of rooms has been changed to aid in the pacing of the game. All in all I think the game has just about tripled in length since it was introduced into Early Access. Thanks to all who are giving me feedback and Enjoy the Game!http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687039/d5db1e09d1429511b6b3021cb6bc6a577bb6f301.jpghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687039/09760f59c759cf7ab622e085ffd617b5819e864f.jpg
